fields.description: Sobha SeaHaven is a waterfront apartment development in Dubai Harbour. The current developer page includes one- to four-bedroom homes, while the earlier linked pack details one-, two- and three-bedroom layouts. Harbour-facing leisure spaces and larger family residences form part of the proposition, with each tower and edition requiring its own plan and specification.
amenities: Health club with sauna and steam

overview: The earlier three-bedroom Type A provides a maid’s room and separate powder room. Current four-bedroom and premium-edition homes are not assigned those earlier plan areas. Furnishing, branded fixtures and included equipment remain specification-specific.
research.locationNote: Dubai Harbour, Dubai, as described in the developer’s own project materials. No nearby district is substituted for the project address.
research.priceNote: The own developer page fetched on 31 October 2026 advertises AED 4,220,000 from, subject to inventory availability. This is a published guide, not a checked available unit, valuation or binding offer. Other historical launch advertisements may use a different price or unit mix.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder lists 20/40/40 and a separate 20/20/60 option. These are historical or tower-specific possibilities, not a verified offer for every SeaHaven home. Current developer payment dates were unavailable.
research.handoverNote: Developer catalogue: August 2027. Property Finder’s key information says April 2028 and its FAQ still says April 2026. Without a reconciled tower-specific developer document, no single handover headline is assigned.
